definitions: A substance like air that is not a liquid or a solid and burns easily.
A gas or mixture of gases used as a fuel.
A natural underground store of gas.
A substance like air that is used to make people unconscious for medical operations.
A substance like air that is used as a weapon.
A substance like air that is produced when food in your stomach and bowels is digested.
A substance like air that is used to fill balloons.
A substance like air that is used to power engines.
